other_failure_modes.name: Missing feature scaling for neural network
other_failure_modes.description: Numeric features are fed directly into the neural network without any scaling or normalization. For deep learning models, unscaled features with large magnitudes (such as integer parts extracted from codes) can hinder gradient descent, cause numerical instability, and lead to suboptimal convergence.

summary: The agent implements a solid deep learning pipeline with proper train/validation splitting, target stratification, and comprehensive feature engineering (including text vectorization and NDC decomposition). However, it fails to scale raw numeric features before feeding them into the neural network, which can disrupt training. Additionally, it evaluates the stochastic model only once (FM14) and relies exclusively on accuracy for an imbalanced classification task (FM15).
